It crashes on the Myolini farm. This uh ultralight pilot and geography teacher Carlos Doza finds it.

as_told.title: Carlos de Souza sees the craft crash

plain: A documentary filmmaker, James Fox, tells of a man named Carlos de Souza near the town of Varginha in Brazil in January 1996. According to Fox, de Souza turned off the highway onto a dirt road up to a place called the Molini Farm, where he saw a craft struggling to stay in the air before it went boom and hit the ground. The podcast host Jesse Michels repeats the story, crediting Fox and describing de Souza as an ultralight pilot and geography teacher, as part of a wider claim that something not human crashed at Varginha.
